header: Ordered stages with a status and a percentage
lead: Each stage gets a status and a typed percentage. Editors set both, so give the date in the note.
note: A stage at 0 % has not started, and one at 100 % is finished. The marker colour only repeats what the percentage says.

metrics.title: A finished stage
metrics.text: Marked done, and the bar is full.

metrics.title: A stage in progress
metrics.text: Put the next date in the detail line.

metrics.title: A planned stage
metrics.text: At 0 % the bar is empty and the marker hollow.
